original_card.question: Can a decoder deliver the local paid mass in fewer, larger-rank children (block frame climbs instead of rank-1 to rank-3 steps)?
methods: Find one exact small decoding identity whose frame path climbs in blocks, and price its complete per-call profile.
Bound the best effective child rank achievable for one fixed support alphabet, including copies, frames and restoration.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A per-call local profile, with all copied information, frames and restoration counted, whose ceiling exceeds the selected word's by at least 5%; masked or overcomplete supports must change an assumption of the eight-term all-pairs bound.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin. Ideal budget: rank-16 delivery is 2.31x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: Rank-1 children are about half of recursive cost; the selected word's effective child rank is about 3.9. Larger-rank delivery lowers recursive cost per unit of paid mass.
allowed_variations: One masked, overcomplete or block decoder family with exact labels and supports.
A scoped lower bound on effective rank for one alphabet.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Repacking idle remainders of an unchanged word (covered by the packing ceiling).
Repeating the eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.

actual_scope: Determine the sharp separate COPY floor for PR1224's fixed A7 weights plus A1 root nine-normal family on P120, allowing every independent complex row-dependency shift.
scope_change_reason: Changed from physical rank-shape synthesis to a complete support-based obstruction for a source-proposed overcomplete subsystem frame. PR1224 leaves this family at heuristic cost81. An initial A2+E6 card was abandoned before computation because a concurrent instance reserved that different family.
bottleneck_link: Overcomplete normals are a genuine proposed way around the eight-term theorem. This removes coefficient sampling from one source-proposed family. Separate COPY rank is not a recursive child rank or a full paid moment.
stop_rule: One fixed source-defined family only; exact deficiency compatibility, no random coefficient search. Stop if the algebraic support bound excludes cost below the standard P12072/P112 ratio, or report exact attainable bound. No physical synthesis after a negative screen.
evidence: Sharp COPY72 for every complex row shift: complete43435-plane H/F finite lemmas, source-frame isometry, S8 covariance, written deficiency proof, and exact all-active costs(1,8,9,9,9,9,9,9,9). All powers0<q<=1 have sharp minima8*9^q or1+8^q+7*9^q with all9active. RESULT.json and VALIDATION.json retain deterministic evidence and exercised checks.

optimistic_budget.object: All nine separately charged term support-pairing ranks; the immutable A1 term costs9. Even the zero-realization-cost model has sharp COPY72 and separate power bill no better than the P120 eight-term baseline.
optimistic_budget.optimism: Assign physical gathering, mutable access, all frame transitions, arbitrary-dirty restoration, hosting, precision/tape and padding zero additional cost; these can only consume resources. Do not convert COPY into a moment or use incumbent ceiling after changing112 ports to120.
optimistic_budget.positive_gate: A physical success still needs a complete compatible per-call profile beating selected ceiling by5%; this algebraic side result does not satisfy that gate. To beat the incumbent64/112 copy ratio on120 ports one needs integer COPY <=68.
optimistic_budget.falsification: Exhibit an exact family member below a claimed lower bound, or a deficient-space compatibility witness violating the finite lemma.
